basket-champs.title: Basket Champs: Shoot Hoops & Challenge the World
basket-champs.slogan: Master your skills, compete in tournaments, and see how you stack up!
basket-champs.description: Basket Champs is your ultimate basketball challenge. Compete in heart-stopping matches and prove your skills in the World Championship Tournament. Start by choosing a national team and aim to score more points than your opponent in five throws. Align your direction and force accurately to make the best shots. Advance through rounds by winning convincingly and conquer the championship!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Basket Champs: Shoot Hoops & Challenge the World
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Basket Champs is a thrilling basketball game where you can master your skills, compete in tournaments, and see how you stack up against other players. Prove your mettle in heart-stopping matches and aim for the championship!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Track the direction of the ball's throw with a dotted line on the screen.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Analyze the position of the ball and the nature of the basket (whether it moves or not).
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Move the mouse to adjust the direction and force of the throw, then click to make your turn.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Select a national team to represent throughout the season.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Align direction and force accurately to score the best shots.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Win convincingly to move on to the next round with more formidable opponents.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Compete in the World Championship Tournament and prove your skills!
